$schema: Manifest defined by the repository agent harness (Phase 2; plan archived to dev-docs/plans/completed/2026-09-03-repo-agent-harness.md in PR #13).
description: Curated entry points and policy locations used by scripts/repo.mjs. The author who adds, removes, or relocates a listed target updates this file in the same PR.

categories.entry-point: Process entry point: the file that boots a service, runner, or top-level command.
categories.runtime-service: A long-lived service module: route registration, agent wiring, or background work that runs while the app is up.
categories.persistence-boundary: An on-disk state location that the backend reads or writes (sessions, ledger, provenance, jobs, skills).
categories.policy: A document or file that defines a rule an agent or human must follow (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, fork guard, hook).
categories.verification: A file that defines or runs a check (CI workflow, test config, verification ladder doc).
categories.developer-documentation: A canonical contributor/developer document under docs/development/ or dev-docs/.
categories.product-documentation: A product-facing document under docs/ that describes a feature to users.
categories.release-record: A file that records or governs a release (CHANGELOG, version source, release workflow).

entries.name: Cross-platform launcher
entries.description: Cross-platform Node launcher that installs deps, seeds skills, and starts backend + frontend together. Wrapped by start.sh (macOS/Linux) and start.cmd (Windows). The only supported full-app path.

entries.name: Fastify backend entry
entries.description: Fastify server bootstrap (port 8000): registers routes, installs the undici EnvHttpProxyAgent as the global dispatcher, and sets up the AsyncLocalStorage scope onRequest hook.

entries.name: Backend prep
entries.description: Ensures a default project exists and seeds scientific skills. Run via `npm run prep` in server/.

entries.name: Next.js App Router
entries.description: Next.js 16 App Router entry. The dev server (`next dev`), production build, and the App Router layout/page tree live here.

entries.name: Pi session registry
entries.description: Holds live Pi AgentSession objects (one per chat tab, ≤10 per project) and persists them as JSONL files under the project's sessions/ directory.

entries.name: Model runtime + registry
entries.description: Resolves canonical provider/model refs (openrouter/, ollama/, nvidia/, subscription providers) to Pi Model objects and synthesizes OpenRouter pricing for non-built-in models.

entries.name: SSE event mapper
entries.description: Maps Pi AgentSessionEvent to the SSE schema (text_delta, thinking_delta, tool_start/update/end, turn_start/end, error, cost, done) consumed by the frontend.

entries.name: Sandbox API routes
entries.description: File ops, annotation sidecars, LaTeX compile/SyncTeX, latex-assist, and the scientific preview dispatcher (sci-summary / sci-render.png).

entries.name: Sessions API routes
entries.description: Session lifecycle: create, run, history, interview answers, notebook, and the methods-draft one-shot.

entries.name: Durable Modal job manager
entries.description: Owns persistent Modal jobs under .kady/modal/, including budget reservations, abort-safe sandbox creation, retry, batches, and restart recovery through saved sandbox ids.

entries.name: Cost ledger
entries.description: Snapshots session stats before/after each run and appends one row to sandbox/.kady/runs/<sessionId>/costs.jsonl (role: agent | subagent | compute).

entries.name: Provenance recorder
entries.description: Derives one observed step per tool call from the session subscribe stream and appends to sandbox/.kady/provenance/<sessionId>/steps.jsonl. No agent-facing tool writes here.

entries.name: Skills sync writer
entries.description: Sole writer of live skill directories. Manifest v2 lives at sandbox/.kady/skills-sync.json with per-skill origin, ref, catalogueDigest, and removed tombstones.

entries.name: Projects registry & sessions store
entries.description: Owns the projects registry and on-disk state under projects/<id>/sandbox/.pi/sessions/ (gitignored runtime data). One JSONL per chat tab; replayed for reopened tabs and harvested for subagent provenance + notebook entries. This entry points at the owning module because the data location itself is not committed.

entries.name: Root repository policy
entries.description: Cross-agent entry point and policy boundary: fork, hook, release, version, platform, and harness invariants. Canonical policy for this repository.

entries.name: Backend policy
entries.description: Scoped backend deltas: Fastify/Pi conventions, test boundaries, helper venv, sandbox boundary, model billing touchpoints, Pi runtime vs contributor policy.

entries.name: Frontend policy
entries.description: Scoped frontend deltas: Next.js/React conventions, viewer registry, capability-hub structure, frontend tests.

entries.name: Automation & release policy
entries.description: Scoped automation deltas: workflow permissions, action pinning, secrets, matrix testing, release automation.

entries.name: Claude Code compatibility pointer
entries.description: Short pointer telling Claude Code to read and follow the root AGENTS.md. Validated by docs:check (Phase 5) for exact template; must not accrete a second policy.

entries.name: Gemini CLI compatibility pointer
entries.description: Short pointer telling Gemini CLI to read and follow the root AGENTS.md. Same template rules as CLAUDE.md.

entries.name: Pre-push fork guard
entries.description: Blocks pushes to any remote that is not the fork. Activated by start.mjs via `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`. Do not bypass.

entries.name: Release workflow
entries.description: Runs on every push to main; if the tag v<version> doesn't exist it creates it plus a GitHub release with auto-generated notes. No manual tagging.

entries.name: Tests workflow
entries.description: Runs backend (typecheck + vitest) and frontend (typecheck + lint + build + vitest) on ubuntu + windows, plus the launcher --check smoke on ubuntu/macos/windows, on PR and push to main. Also runs on documentation-only PRs.

entries.name: Harness pin update check
entries.description: Compares pinned Pi harness packages against npm's `latest` dist-tag. Report-only; never upgrades.

entries.name: Backend vitest config
entries.description: Vitest config that points KADY_PROJECTS_ROOT at a temp dir so tests do not touch user projects.

entries.name: Repository command hub
entries.description: Portable Node command hub: status, map, verify (fast/server/web/docs/all), handoff:check, release:check, work:plan/handoff/maintenance scaffolders. Delegates to existing server/web scripts; never bypasses hooks or CI.

entries.name: Repository manifest
entries.description: Curated navigation and policy locations used by `npm run repo:map` and `docs:check`. Update in the same PR as any target relocation.

entries.name: Developer documentation index
entries.description: Entry point for contributor/developer documentation. Defines the category table, ownership/freshness table, and rules for adding a new document.

entries.name: Architecture map
entries.description: Package, module, and data-flow boundaries. Owned by the cross-cutting area; updated when a new entry point or data flow is added.

entries.name: Verification ladder
entries.description: Fast targeted checks, package checks, full local checks, and CI matrix mapping. Owned by the cross-cutting area; updated when a command or matrix changes.

entries.name: Repository agent harness plan
entries.description: Implementation plan for the repository agent harness. Defines the layered interface, source-of-truth order, command hub, handoff schema, and rollout phases.

entries.name: Maintenance log
entries.description: Append-only record of security, dependency, CI/tooling, and operational decisions with evidence and follow-ups.

entries.name: Roadmap TODO
entries.description: Prioritized, non-authoritative roadmap. Not a state record; handoffs and PRs are the coordination mechanism.

entries.name: Product architecture
entries.description: User-facing architecture description: runtime, services, persistence, and integration boundaries.

entries.name: File previews
entries.description: User-facing coverage of supported scientific file previews. Update when a new viewer is added to web/src/lib/viewers/registry.ts.

entries.name: Limitations
entries.description: User-facing limitations: provider refusals, trust boundary, harness pinning. Short and explicit.

entries.name: Modal compute
entries.description: User-facing guide to durable Modal remote compute: how to configure, submit, and reconcile jobs.

entries.name: Provenance
entries.description: User-facing description of provenance: what is observed, what is derived, and what is out of scope (nested subagents, Modal, env capture).

entries.name: Skill management
entries.description: User-facing guide to project vs global skills, manifest v2 semantics, install/update flows, and the catalogue sync cadence.

entries.name: Changelog
entries.description: Keep-a-Changelog formatted release notes. The Unreleased section is updated in the implementing PR; entries move under [version] - YYYY-MM-DD as part of release prep.

entries.name: Server version source
entries.description: Single source of truth for the app version. web/package.json deliberately has no version field. Bumping the version is what triggers the release workflow on main.

entries.name: Dependabot config
entries.description: Dependabot configuration for server/ and web/ packages. Not used for the pinned Pi harness packages, which the project upgrades deliberately.
